I’m Pratik Kumar, a BCA AI & ML student interested in programming, computer science and creative technology.

I’m at the start of the journey — and that’s the exciting part. Every week brings a new concept: how programs run, how data moves, how machines can learn. I’m building strong fundamentals first, so everything I create later stands on solid ground.

Off the keyboard, I’m drawn to design, editing and the way visuals and technology come together — the same curiosity that shaped this portfolio.
